channel.title: Pier & Point · MB360
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for MB360 (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · MB360: MB360's 188 units now cite the Assessor roll alone; the architect's page cited gives no unit count for this block. The 2014 fire is described as CBS News did: the unfinished building was destroyed and demolished.
item.description: MB360's 188 units now cite the Assessor roll alone; the architect's page cited gives no unit count for this block. The 2014 fire is described as CBS News did: the unfinished building was destroyed and demolished. Source: DataSF Assessor Secured Roll wv5m-vpq2, parcel 8710009; Ignition Architecture, MB 360º project page; CBS News San Francisco, 2014-05-07.

item.description: Added a photo taken on site on September 30, 2026. Source: Pier & Point editorial decision.

item.title: Correction · MB360: The map notes said the unit count was unresolved between 188 and 360 and that the building dated from 2014. Ignition Architecture gives 362 units for the two blocks together and 2016 for completion, and the Assessor gives 188 units and 2016 for this parcel, so the notes now say that. The summary no longer states a 2014 Essex acquisition year (no cited source gives one), the CBS News source title now matches the displayed headline, the 2013 milestone also cites Ignition for Blocks 5 and 11, and the Commons photo no longer says it was taken from a departing flight.

item.title: Complete · MB360: This block (701 China Basin St) is completed: the Assessor roll (DataSF, parcel 8710009) gives year built 2016 and 188 units, and the architect's project page (Ignition Architecture) gives "Completion 2016"; that page gives no unit count for this block (~2016)
